headline: Automate full-cycle video production with MoneyPrinterTurbo
lede: This platform integrates LLMs and multi-modal models to turn keywords into finished video content. It bridges the gap between raw intent and polished assets through a fully automated pipeline.

headline: Munder Difflin coordinates autonomous agents within a virtual office
lede: By wrapping command-line coding assistants in a 2D floorplan environment, this system enables disparate agents to communicate via a shared mailbox. It provides a visual structure for complex task delegation and autonomous project management.

headline: AI-Memory provides a shared ledger for fragmented coding assistants
lede: Persistent context remains the primary challenge in AI-assisted software development. This middleware captures lifecycle observations across various platforms to ensure architectural continuity as you switch between different agents.

headline: OpenViking organizes agent knowledge via a virtual filesystem
lede: Moving beyond black-box vector stores, this architecture exposes retrieval data through a deterministic, directory-based protocol. It offers fine-grained observability into how agents navigate and synthesize their long-term knowledge.

headline: Standardized skill library equips AI agents for cybersecurity defense
lede: This repository formalizes complex security workflows into a machine-readable format compatible with modern LLM interfaces. It maps investigative procedures to established industry frameworks to enable specialized autonomous threat hunting.

headline: A definitive index of public APIs for modern software builds
lede: Connecting your application to external services requires a reliable starting point. This community-curated collection streamlines integration by organizing high-quality endpoints into an accessible, developer-focused directory.

headline: Omarchy delivers a refined and opinionated Linux experience
lede: Focusing on strict design defaults, this distribution minimizes the configuration overhead typical of modern desktop Linux. It provides a stable and intentional environment for those prioritizing usability over customization.

headline: Motrix adds modular plugin support to cross-platform downloads
lede: With a decoupled core and UI, this manager brings enterprise-grade download orchestration to desktop and headless environments. The new JSON-RPC architecture allows for seamless interaction across browser extensions and command-line tools.

headline: AERIS-10 makes phased array radar accessible for researchers
lede: This modular radar system demystifies complex radio frequency design through open-source schematics and firmware. It provides a complete toolchain for signal processing, from FPGA-level beam steering to Python-based visualization.

headline: oMLX manages high-performance local inference on Apple Silicon
lede: Balancing local convenience with server-grade control, this tool manages model lifecycles through a native macOS interface. Its tiered KV cache and distributed inference features extend the limits of local model deployment.
